summary: Full backend + frontend testing of new ONLINE MULTIPLAYER feature plus regression of local mode. Wrote 9 new pytest tests covering room create/join/full/host-only bots/start/join-after-start/redaction/action-validation/e2e full-round game — all 9 PASS (plus 5 pre-existing games endpoints still PASS). Frontend Playwright verified: HomeScreen shows both modes, Play Online → CreateJoin → Create → Lobby with room code + copy link + bot controls, Start disabled below 3 players, Add 2 bots + Start → passing phase with 20 cards (3-player deal) → confirmed pass of 3 cards → trick play through 20 tricks with trick-winner-banner + continue-trick → Reckoning (score rows + Commence Next Round). Two-context test: created room in one context, opened deep link ?room=CODE in a second isolated browser context (code prefilled), joined as PlayerB, host lobby updated to show PlayerB via polling, both contexts entered passing with 20 own-hand cards and ZERO card-id overlap (privacy verified). Local mode regression: setup screen with 3/4/5/6 witches + Solo vs AI preset works.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown') — migrate to FastAPI lifespan handlers.
In-memory _locks dict grows unbounded per room code with no eviction; fine for MVP but should be pruned when rooms end/expire.
manage_bots does not check if action string is one of {'add','remove'} — an unknown action silently no-ops and still calls _save_room (increments version). Minor: consider rejecting with 400.
_advance_bots has hard cap of 500 iterations but no exception path if reached — defensive limit only.
GameResult.created_at stored as ISO string; sorting works because ISO-8601 is lexicographically sortable but native BSON date would be more robust.
OnlineTable copy-link uses navigator.clipboard without HTTPS/permission fallback; acceptable in preview but no user feedback (toast) after copy.
Room documents are never garbage-collected (no TTL index or cleanup) — will accumulate in MongoDB over time.
seed_data_creation: Multiple rooms created with TEST_ prefixed player names; some game_results rows created by e2e full-game test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend room tests at /app/backend/tests/test_rooms.py (9 tests). Full-game test exercises one complete round through Reckoning with host + 2 bots. Two-context privacy test confirmed via Playwright: no overlap between own hands across contexts and GET /api/rooms only returns yourHand. Deep link ?room=CODE prefills join input. Bot auto-play verified server-side (round completes) and client-side (20 tricks resolved).
